fee_notes: Royalty is 6% of Gross Sales, payable weekly. Marketing and Technology Fee is currently 1% of Gross Sales (max 2%), payable weekly; may be reallocated to Regional Advertising Program. Loyalty & Gift Program Fee: $200–$225/month (third party). Third Party & Online Ordering Fee: $74.99/month plus $0.10/transaction. Location & Review Management Fee: $27.50/month. Digital Menu Screen Fee (Café with Drive Thru only): $5.15/month. LMS License Fee: $110/month (year 1), $100/month thereafter. Mystery Shopper Program Fee: $39–$44/visit (at least monthly; weekly during first 90 days). Local Advertising Expenditure: currently none, but up to 1% of Gross Sales may be required in future. Regional Advertising Fee: currently none, may be established up to 1% of Gross Sales. Additional Meeting Fee: up to $750/attendee/meeting (up to 2/year). Tech fee is bundled into the Marketing and Technology Fee percentage rather than a separate flat monthly amount.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty | 6% of your actual Gross Sales | Payable weekly on Monday based on the prior week's Gross Sales
Marketing and Technology Fee | Currently 1% of your actual Gross Sales | Payable weekly with the Royalty based on the prior week's Gross Sales | We may reallocate all or a portion of this fee to a Regional Advertising Program if one is established in your region. We reserve the right to increase the required contribution up to a maximum of 2% of your Gross Sales.
Loyalty & Gift Program Fee | Currently $200 to $225/month, depending on factors including the number of total participating outlets at the time, numbers of e-mails sent, and other factors established by the third party supplier | Monthly, within seven days of invoice
Third Party & Online Ordering Fee | Currently $74.99 per month plus $0.10 per transaction | Monthly, within seven days of invoice
Location & Review Management Fee | $27.50/month | Monthly, within seven days of invoice
Digital Menu Screen Fee (for Café with Drive Thru Locations Only) | $5.15/month | Monthly, within seven days of invoice
Product, Supply, and Service Purchases | Current published prices | Payable on invoicing or as otherwise described in the Operations Manual
Local Advertising Expenditure | Currently none, but we may require you to spend at least 1% of your Gross Sales on local advertising in the future | As incurred
Regional Advertising Fee | Currently none, but we may establish requirements in the future which will limit the amount of the fees the regional advertising cooperative may impose to no more than 1% of Gross Sales without our consent | To be Determined
Learning Management System (LMS) License Fee | Currently $110 per month for a shop's first year of operations and $100 per month thereafter; can increase on 30 days' notice | Monthly
Mystery Shopper Program Fee | Currently $39 to $44 per visit, depending on location and amount of travel required | Following each mystery shopper visit
Additional Meeting Fee | Will vary, but not to exceed $750 per attendee per meeting | As incurred
Costs of Inspection and Audit | Cost of audit, underpayment amount, late payment charges and interest. Varies according to your location / If you commit an Act of Deception, $25,000 | Immediately on receipt of our notice
